verdict.rationale: The evidence covers only on-demand package-manager commands: install, audit, update, dedupe, prune and publish. Nothing documents a way to schedule or run automations autonomously in the background. Community praise for Bun's shell-scripting API concerns the runtime and is at most a developer building block, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background
